pairs.difference: A: the mid-dark blue mailbox sits as one clean mass against a light sky and field. The darkest accents are small (the knob, the shadow under the box), and contrast is moderate. B: the corners are broken up by near-black tree foliage at the top left and right and by a dark trunk running down the whole card. The darks are scattered across the background instead of grouped on the hero, which pushes contrast to 0.204, above the real range. The feeder's mid-grey has little value separation from the trunk behind it.
pairs.fix: Keep the background trees soft and mid-light with no black leaf masses in the corners. Put the darkest shadows on the feeder itself, under the roof and inside the seed tray.

pairs.difference: A: the wood is washed pale, with a lighter glow behind the plate. The fruit is broken into many small light and dark spots (seeds, berries, droplets) with no single dark mass, and overall contrast is low (0.115, below the real range). B: the beans form one solid dark oval inside a bright metal rim against mid-value wood, so the groups are clear.
pairs.fix: Give the plate of fruit one large shadowed side and a darker cast shadow on the table. Keep the wood a steady mid-tone with no pale glow behind the plate.

pairs.difference: Both cards have a dark green corner vignette and a lighter ray burst. A: the pale ring sits tight around the jacket like a halo, and the vignette (0.134) is slightly above the real range. The dark sash is the only strong dark accent. B: the hat's light crown rolls off to a mid-grey brim with a light underside. The differences are small.
pairs.fix: Soften the corner darkening and let the ray burst fade out gradually instead of forming a bright ring that hugs the jacket.

pairs.difference: B: the cap is an almost-black block set inside a pale disc glow centred right behind it, the halo-behind-hero pattern seen in the generated lesson cards. The hero is far darker than its surround (gap -0.312, well outside the real range). A: the white clock face sits against a busy mid-value station scene, and the darks are spread across the beams and rails.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright circle glow behind the cap and keep the background rings an even mid-blue. Light the top board of the cap so it reads mid-blue rather than black.

pairs.difference: A: the whole wagon sits small and fully inside the frame and is lit evenly. The canopy is near white and the ground and sky are both light, so the card is high-key overall (lightness 0.712, above the real range), and the only dark mass is the canopy opening. B: the coaster cars are large and cropped by the frame, with dark blue track framing them and some darkening in the sky at the top.
pairs.fix: Bring the wagon closer so it fills and crops the frame. Shade the far side of the canopy and the underside of the wagon bed into a clear mid-dark, and lower the overall brightness of the ground.

pairs.difference: A: a small guitar lies on large wood planks. The planks are bright in the centre and darken toward the corners, and the hero's value is close to the wood, so it separates mostly by hue. Its darkest accents are thin lines (the strings and the soundhole). B: a large racket with a black grip and a white court line, giving clear big light and dark groups on a mid-green field.
pairs.fix: Make the guitar larger in the frame and give it a darker shaded side and a firm cast shadow. Keep the wood an even mid-tone without darkened corners.

pairs.difference: A: thin light-grey spurs on a light cyan ring background. The card is very light (0.763), contrast is at the bottom of the real range (0.086), and the hero barely separates by value, with only small dark spots on the straps. B: the large blue pillow has a deep dark inner shadow and a white hole, so the dark and mid masses are clear against a pale pink background.
pairs.fix: Make the spurs larger and darken the leather straps and the shadow sides of the metal. Make the background a slightly deeper blue so the steel stands out as the lighter shape.

pairs.difference: B: a light glow sits directly behind the boots (the pale halo shape is visible on the lens), the boots are lit evenly and mostly light-mid, and both stand fully inside the frame. A: the big red gloves are cropped at the left edge, with large mid-dark masses, deep black shadows between them, and lighter corners.
pairs.fix: Remove the light patch behind the boots so the blue wall stays an even tone. Let the boot shafts fall into a darker shaded side and deepen the shadow on the floor between them.

pairs.difference: B: a bright white column against near-black maroon walls. The card is low-key (lightness 0.514, below the real range) and the hero-to-background gap of 0.295 is far above the real range, a spotlit look the real cards never use. A: a bright, light-key golf scene with a mid-grey club and ball against light grass and sky.
pairs.fix: Light the whole room brightly, with the wall a medium raspberry pink rather than near black. Keep the column light, but let the background sit only a step or two darker.

pairs.difference: B: a big flat orange wall above a floor that goes almost pure white, so a large clipped light area takes up half the card (lightness 0.762, above the real range). The sneakers are the only mid-dark mass, and the background has no gradient. A: the cactus sits in a spotlight glow with darker purple corners, and its values are moderate with low contrast.
pairs.fix: Tone the floor down to a warm mid-light yellow with a soft shadow under the shoes, and avoid any pure white areas.

pairs.difference: B: a pale cyan background with a chrome top that clips to white over a wide band. The card is the brightest of the set (0.809, above the real range), and the darks are only the small vent holes and the red end caps. A: the fan alternates mid and dark purple folds against light yellow, with a white glow just behind it.
pairs.fix: Deepen the background to a medium turquoise. Give the metal cover a darker reflected band along its lower half so the top highlight does not take over the whole cover.

pairs.difference: B: a dark green pump stands fully inside the frame against a very pale sky and ground. It is the only dark mass, and its gap of -0.326 is far outside the real range, so it reads as a cut-out silhouette. A: the viewer is large and cropped by the frame, mid-grey against a light city, and the gap is still large but closer to the real range.
pairs.fix: Bring the pump closer so it crops the frame. Give the pump body a lit green front, and make the sky and ground a warmer mid-tone so the hero is not a near-black shape on a pale field.

pattern: Generated cards place the hero small and fully inside the frame, often with a pale glow or halo directly behind it. The hero tends to sit at a value extreme against its surround: either evenly lit high-key on a washed background, or a near-black mass on a pale field, or a spotlit hero on a dark room. Real cards crop large heroes and group the darks into one or two big masses on the hero. The real backgrounds stay mid-tone, with no tight halo and no clipped white or black fields.
